en: Conditioned by a state accompanied by rapture, a state not accompanied by rapture arises by way of the root-condition.
Conditioned by a state accompanied by rapture, a state not accompanied by pleasure arises by way of the root-condition. Conditioned by a state accompanied by rapture...
Dependent on a state accompanied by rapture, a state not accompanied by equanimity arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state accompanied by rapture, states not accompanied by rapture and not accompanied by equanimity arise by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state accompanied by rapture, states not accompanied by pleasure and not accompanied by equanimity arise by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state accompanied by rapture, states that are neither accompanied by rapture nor accompanied by pleasure arise by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state accompanied by rapture, states that are neither accompanied by rapture, nor accompanied by pleasure,
nor accompanied by equanimity arise by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state accompanied by pleasure, a state not accompanied by pleasure arises by way of root condition … [and so on] … seven.
Dependent on a state accompanied by equanimity, a state not accompanied by equanimity arises by way of root condition … [and so on] … seven.
Dependent on a state accompanied by rapture and accompanied by pleasure, a state not accompanied by rapture arises by way of root condition … [and so on] … seven. (Abbreviated.)
In the case of the root condition, there are twenty-eight; in the case of the object condition, twenty-four … pe … in the case of the non-disappearance condition, twenty-eight.
(The "Conascent" chapter, the "Associated" chapter, and the "Investigation" chapter should all be expanded in full everywhere.)
